author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We take an in-depth hands-on look at XREAL's Project Aura, lightweight glasses that run Google's Android XR. Making their debut at Augmented World Expo, these are the first mixed reality glasses running Qualcomm's latest Snapdragon XR2 Gen 3 (aka Reality Elite) chip. Here's how they work, why optical passthrough is a big deal, and a conversation with XREAL's CEO about their display technology. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
